picks.fit: An ERP workflow with external partners
picks.detail: WeAreBrain names both Truck Tyre Assist and the ERP partner on its breakdown-operations project. Ask a potential delivery team to map ownership of a supplier notification that fails after dispatch. Your operator should be able to find the case, determine its status and reach the right support contact.

picks.fit: A service desk used across regions
picks.detail: Genie’s contact-center project with Slalom covered technology and change management. Ask the bidder to let a supervisor change a queue rule in staging using the written handover. Time the exercise and record where the supervisor needed vendor help. Those gaps belong in the last delivery milestone.

picks.fit: An automation program shared by business units
picks.detail: ZF and Capgemini established a global RPA service. Use the example to ask how a newly hired process owner learns to propose, test and retire an automation. Request a walkthrough of the approval record, the rollback instructions and the person responsible for the next improvement.

methodology: Assess whether your own team can operate the delivered application. Ask every candidate to stage one buyer-led exercise using a company-owned account; document the access, instructions and fallback support it requires.
commercial_relationship: The publisher sells AI implementation services.
questions: If your engineers will take over, ask for a sample repository, runbook and handover schedule.
If the provider will operate the system, agree on incident coverage, escalation and the cost of changes.
Identify who owns evaluation data, infrastructure accounts and deployment access from day one.
pricing: Compare build-and-handover with managed operation over twelve months. Include your own engineers’ time, vendor support and migration costs.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask a contact-center supervisor to change one staging queue before the vendor leaves. Capture the evidence the supervisor used to check routing.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Have an internal engineer trace a failing integration across the vendor and platform support boundaries using a single request ID.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Ask your engineer to reproduce a dataset build, inspect a failed check and identify which schema version was deployed.

firms.name: LowCode Agency
firms.note: Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Try exporting a small application change and restoring it in a clean workspace owned by your company.

firms.name: Goodspeed
firms.note: Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask an operations employee to change an automation after training and explain how to roll it back without waiting for a vendor call.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. Have your operator recover a supplier request that reached the ERP but did not reach the recipient. Time the exercise.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask an internal process lead to submit, test and retire one automation under the proposed governance model.

firms.name: McKinsey QuantumBlack
firms.note: Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Give the buyer’s model owner a drift alert and ask them to identify who can suspend the affected decision.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. Request a transition plan with a named business owner, successor and rehearsal date for each operating role.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Which past project matches our scope, and who owned delivery and handover?
